description: This file contains the implementation of the login page model for the identity area of an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web application. It handles user login requests, external login schemes, and transfers anonymous shopping basket data to the authenticated user post-login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: Razor Page Model for handling user login, managing authentication, and basket transfer post-login.

classes.name: LoginModel.InputModel
classes.description: Holds the login form data: email, password, and remember me option.

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Prepares the login page, clears external cookies, and loads external login schemes.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles the login POST request, authenticates the user, and manages redirection after login.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers basket data stored in cookies to the authenticated user's basket.
